================================================================

Package:  @mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.35 (npm registry, Apache-2.0)
          tarball sha1  ae1ff52d68550e0a4dd971ac6f67ef9aad7f946f
          integrity     sha512-HOvadwVRE6JC+45nyYhmnywnr5h/J8KZvOeUNVOG9q/0875pZgItznFB9bRTvLc264YSJqiZ1NsIpCStJw/egg==

Nothing here is modified.

DO NOT UPGRADE WITHOUT READING THIS
-----------------------------------
0.10.35 is pinned on purpose. From 1.0.0 on (checked in 1.0.0 and 1.2.3) the
bundle sends usage metrics to https://odml.pa.googleapis.com/v1/log by default
(no public option to turn it off was found in the bundle), and its README makes
the app responsible for getting users' consent. 0.10.35 is the last stable
release before 1.0.0 and has no such code: its only network requests are the
ones for the wasm and model files in this folder.
Before moving to a newer version, search vision_bundle.mjs for
"odml.pa.googleapis.com".

Which wasm files are used: on current browsers only
wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js and .wasm. The "nosimd" pair is picked
automatically by browsers without WebAssembly SIMD; the "module" pair is only
used when FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(path, true) is called, which the
tracker does not do.
